div.p: is_disconnected() answers true for Disconnected and AuthenticationFailed; both are re-attempted under the same exponential backoff.

The state change into Connecting is a persisted side effect that happens before an .await. Dropping the poll future there (e.g. as the losing arm of a tokio::select!) strands the node with no socket until the ~10 s connection-setup timeout, so every background task runs its network poll to completion and takes wakeups through the selector's Notify instead.

g.text: disconnected(): close, idle expiry, send failure
